rule: Preserve all existing 三晨星 / 光譜 / 策展集 rules. This file tests placement and data contracts using real repository content; it does not redefine selection criteria.

threeMorningStars.important: No new Three Morning Stars judgement is invented here. Existing canonical rules require an actual editorial selection; until an authoritative selected item is located or made, the site layer remains structurally ready but publicly empty.

specimen.proposition: 把可核驗的書籍、圖集、地圖、考古報告、數位重建與影像資料組織成可閱讀、可檢索、可回到 Jerusalem 3000 evidence 的研究路徑。

specimen.note: This existing collection proves that a curated set may support a Spectrum-positioned Magazine work while containing Dawn Library Works, maps, reports, images and research precedents. The underlying objects remain owned by their canonical surfaces/sources.

contractFindings: 三晨星 contract is sufficient but needs an authoritative real selection before public rendering; do not fabricate one for layout.
光譜 needs multi-axis coordinates plus relation/provenance; Jerusalem 3000 already supplies a strong real specimen.
策展集 needs proposition + grouped/ordered members + provenance; Jerusalem 3000 already has a mature real specimen.

A single subject can simultaneously prove Spectrum and Curated Set behavior without making Spectrum and Curated Set the same thing: Spectrum locates relations; Curated Set composes a route through resources.

The existing Jerusalem 3000 curated collection's old Dawn wording is retained as historical/source authority but its presentation placement is now site-first; Dawn Library members hand off to the Library reader rather than making the whole set a Library-only department.

designImplications.threeMorningStars: Must tolerate radical sparsity and even temporary absence; visual weight comes from editorial judgement, not quantity.
designImplications.spectrum: Needs a relational/continuous spatial grammar capable of simultaneous coordinates, not tabs or a filter sidebar.
designImplications.curatedSets: Needs sequence/composition/path grammar capable of mixed media and cross-surface handoff.
designImplications.shared: All three must use the same modern site-wide editorial design language while remaining visibly different gestures.

next: Locate or create through existing editorial authority the first genuine Three Morning Stars selection; normalize the Jerusalem 3000 curated collection members into canonical content IDs; then add a second Spectrum/Curated Set specimen unrelated to Jerusalem to ensure the model is general rather than project-specific.
